newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela central bank seeks higher rates - Matos.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela central bank seeks higher rates - Matos.

text.p: The Venezuelan central bank has set a monetary policy aimed at raising interest rates, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said on Thursday.
"The central bank is looking for an equilibrium, but there's general agreement that rates have to rise," Matos told a press conference.
Interest rates, as measured by the yield on benchmark six-month monetary stabilization notes, fell to a year-low of 14.35 percent at a 130 billion bolivar auction on Wednesday.
